g.text: U510 is powered from SAFETY3V3, the always-on safety rail. Losing it floats Y: 100k pulldowns keep both EN low. Its output is DRIVE_EN, which now clocks the fault latch (U504) rather than driving the buck directly.

g.desc: U510 is powered from SAFETY3V3, the always-on safety rail. Losing it floats Y: 100k pulldowns keep both EN low. Its output is DRIVE_EN, which now clocks the fault latch (U504) rather than driving the buck directly.

g.text: DRIVE12 = bus LM5164 (TI 12V reference values). LOGIC3V3_EXT = AP63203 from DRIVE12. Both EN held low by 100k.

g.desc: DRIVE12 = bus LM5164 (TI 12V reference values). LOGIC3V3_EXT = AP63203 from DRIVE12. Both EN held low by 100k.

g.text: PWR_FLAG DRIVE12: U501 LM5164 buck output via L501; SW is not a power-OUT

g.desc: PWR_FLAG DRIVE12: U501 LM5164 buck output via L501; SW is not a power-OUT

g.text: U502 pin map per Diodes TSOT26 table; FB tied to VOUT for the fixed 3.3 V variant.

g.desc: U502 pin map per Diodes TSOT26 table; FB tied to VOUT for the fixed 3.3 V variant.

g.text: DRIVE_EN = CTRL_PG AND MAIN_PROVEN_IN. MAIN_PROVEN_IN has a FITTED 0R inhibit to PGND.

g.desc: DRIVE_EN = CTRL_PG AND MAIN_PROVEN_IN. MAIN_PROVEN_IN has a FITTED 0R inhibit to PGND.

g.text: SINK12 = U3 R-78HB12-0.5 output: always bus-fed sink/safety cluster. 1.1 W input envelope, pre-proof only.

g.desc: SINK12 = U3 R-78HB12-0.5 output: always bus-fed sink/safety cluster. 1.1 W input envelope, pre-proof only.

g.text: U505 gives DRIVE_PG its consumer: any PGOOD-low clears the latch, so a buck that drops out of regulation cannot silently keep the enable asserted.

g.desc: U505 gives DRIVE_PG its consumer: any PGOOD-low clears the latch, so a buck that drops out of regulation cannot silently keep the enable asserted.

g.text: U504 is the DRIVE12 fault latch: Q holds the enable off after one OVP trip until CLR_N is released. Powered from SAFETY3V3 so it survives a DRIVE12 collapse; PRE_N tied high so it cannot be set remotely.

g.desc: U504 is the DRIVE12 fault latch: Q holds the enable off after one OVP trip until CLR_N is released. Powered from SAFETY3V3 so it survives a DRIVE12 collapse; PRE_N tied high so it cannot be set remotely.

g.text: U503 output asserts DRIVE_OV_TRIP low when DRIVE12 exceeds 2.5V*(R523+R524)/R524 = 16.25 V nominal. Independent of the LM5164 FB node, so an open FB divider cannot hide the fault. It drives the latch (U504), not the buck directly: see RAIL-16.

g.desc: U503 output asserts DRIVE_OV_TRIP low when DRIVE12 exceeds 2.5V*(R523+R524)/R524 = 16.25 V nominal. Independent of the LM5164 FB node, so an open FB divider cannot hide the fault. It drives the latch (U504), not the buck directly: see RAIL-16.

g.text: Enable chain: DRIVE_EN -> U504 clock -> Q = DRIVE_EN_GATED -> U501 EN/UVLO via R514. A latched fault holds DRIVE_EN_GATED low, so the buck stays disabled until the manual reset releases CLR_N.

g.desc: Enable chain: DRIVE_EN -> U504 clock -> Q = DRIVE_EN_GATED -> U501 EN/UVLO via R514. A latched fault holds DRIVE_EN_GATED low, so the buck stays disabled until the manual reset releases CLR_N.

g.text: U501 is TI figure 7-1 (12 V/1 A/300 kHz) with RRON=100k and RFB1/RFB2=453k/49.9k. PGOOD drives DRIVE_PG only.

g.desc: U501 is TI figure 7-1 (12 V/1 A/300 kHz) with RRON=100k and RFB1/RFB2=453k/49.9k. PGOOD drives DRIVE_PG only.

g.text: NOT SAFE TO ENERGIZE. Partition of the former single AUX12V; no release or energization claim.

g.desc: NOT SAFE TO ENERGIZE. Partition of the former single AUX12V; no release or energization claim.
